title: Software licence expired
symptom: Design software says the licence has expired
user_description: My design program says my licence has expired and it won't let me edit anything. I have a client deadline tomorrow!

options.text: Install a cracked version so she can keep working
options.why: Pirated software breaks the law and the licence terms, and cracked files often contain malware.

options.text: Put a colleague's licence key on her PC as well
options.why: Using one licence on two PCs usually breaks the licence terms and can get both accounts blocked.

options.text: Check the licence records to confirm the expiry, and request a renewal through the proper approval process, offering an approved alternative for urgent work
options.why: Confirming the expiry shows whether it is a real expiry or a lost assignment. Renewing through approval keeps the company legal, and an approved alternative helps with the deadline.

options.text: Tell her to ignore the warning and keep working
options.why: The software will not let her edit, so ignoring it does not solve anything.

hints: Is the licence really expired, or just not assigned to her?
Who must approve spending on a renewal?
How could she still meet the deadline while you sort the licence?
real_world_tip: Keep a list of renewal dates. Most expired-licence tickets are avoidable with a reminder a month ahead.
